credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/clover.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BOBBING. Gesture: the trefoil wakes (the head starts folded shut, as clover leaflets really fold at night, opens, pops wider than rest, held, and settles; the dew drop falls off the spade leaf). One hue: a blue-green shade and clover green; white is the chevrons, the lit rims and the dew. Sport: 'Purpurascens Quadrifolium' (burgundy leaves).
